title: ForkInteractions
description: Tiny plugin to handle interactions with sizeable forks.
body:
Its all those interactions you've ever wanted in one.
... or just one.

The whole idea about this plugin is ensuring you have the control over what happens with big forks (tridents) depending on who throws them.

You can change the yml file containing a single setting that controls one interaction:

Can the thrown forks without enchantments be picked up by an entity different to the one who threw it?

If true, well, just pick it up!

If false, well, -- so sad... -- you can't.

For commands, you have 2 choices:
/forkinteractions <status | reload>

Status tells you what you've set in the yml file.
Reload... well, you know.

Setting is in a config yml file in the ForkInteractions' folder.
